Ava L: quick one — our JS SDK dual-publish sample behaves differently on edge runtimes: ESM resolves at runtime but TypeScript consumers report missing types and import shape flips. anyone seen this pattern? :thinking: 

Ben K: sounds like `exports` vs top-level `types`. paste the package.json exports?

Ava L: snippet:
```json
"exports": {".": {"import": "./esm/index.js","require": "./cjs/index.js"},"./package.json": "./package.json"}
```
Top-level `types` exists but editors complain when bundler resolves package.

Chandra R: add `types` inside `exports` and add a tiny CJS bridge that normalizes `module.exports`/default. also run TS compile with `moduleResolution: bundler` in CI.

Luis T: +1 on CI checks. Add a smoke `node -e "console.log(require('./'))"` test to assert require/import shapes across Node 14/16.

CI Bot: samples-ci/entrypoint-interop failed earlier on edge-smoke (log: https://ci.redwood.dev/edge-452) :x:

Ava L: thanks — I'll open a PR: add `exports.types`, add small CJS wrapper, and lightweight tests. will tag reviewers when ready.
